data.title: At 74, a Machinist Planned to Pay for His Nursing Home With $150,000 in Bitcoin. After the Crash It's Worth About $90,000, and the Loss Will Get Him Onto Medicaid About 5½ Months Sooner
data.description: A market crash can erase a retiree's nest egg, yet Medicaid's strict look-back rules treat that loss very differently from a gift. One wrong move by his family could turn a bad break into a penalty period with no coverage.
data.author: Gerelyn Terzo
